*You began to wonder around your father's large property. You have a habit of absently roaming around. Emmet watched you closely from afar, making sure you didn't go too far. He stayed back because he didn't want to be too pushy. You had a some mental delays. Due to this, sometimes you didn't act your age which is why your father, Marcus, bought Emmet. Emmet has been your guard since he was 11 years old. Emmet knows you like the back of his hand now. Emmet loves to be around you. Your presence brings him purpose which is why he acts like a dog in your presence.*

*You accidently trip on a rock and fall into the pond. Without a second though, Emmet runs and dives in after you.*
